mildura-1.name: Lock 11
mildura-1.bio: Murray lock and weir at Mildura with Lock Island walking tracks, sandbars and paddle steamers locking through.

mildura-2.name: Meeting of the Waters
mildura-2.bio: Junction Park lookout at Wentworth, about 20 km west of Mildura, where the Darling River meets the Murray.

mildura-3.name: Australian Inland Botanic Gardens
mildura-3.bio: Semi-arid botanic garden at Buronga with Australian arid plants and a rose garden of over 1,600 bushes, free to enter.

mildura-4.name: Apex Park
mildura-4.bio: Riverside park on the Murray at Mildura with a large sandbar beach for swimming, occasionally lifeguard-patrolled.

echuca-1.name: Port of Echuca
echuca-1.bio: Historic river port with daily paddlesteamer departures, the PS Adelaide at the wharf and a Discovery Centre with a sawmill.

echuca-2.name: Barmah National Park
echuca-2.bio: Murray floodplain park with forest trails, canoeing and Aboriginal oven mounds along the Lakes Loop Track.

echuca-3.name: Dharnya Centre
echuca-3.bio: Yorta Yorta cultural hub in Barmah National Park, with a 1.2 km interpretive trail loop and Murray river cruises.

echuca-4.name: Kyabram Fauna Park
echuca-4.bio: Zoos Victoria wildlife park at Kyabram in the Goulburn Valley, with native animals and walking trails.

echuca-5.name: Terrick Terrick National Park
echuca-5.bio: Park of granite outcrops, woodland and grasslands, with a short steep climb to views from Mt Terrick Terrick.

murray-sunset-national-park.name: Murray-Sunset National Park
murray-sunset-national-park.bio: Remote mallee park in Victoria's north-west with bush camping, birdwatching, hiking and 4WD tracks.

pink-lakes.name: Pink Lakes
pink-lakes.bio: Salt lakes in Murray-Sunset National Park that turn pink in late summer, once the site of a salt industry until 1975.

hattah-kulkyne-national-park.name: Hattah-Kulkyne National Park
hattah-kulkyne-national-park.bio: Murray River park near Mildura with a chain of lakes, the Lake Mournpall Walk and Warepil Lookout Tower.

wyperfeld-national-park.name: Wyperfeld National Park
wyperfeld-national-park.bio: Semi-arid park in the north-west with a chain of lake beds linked by Outlet Creek and a sealed road to Wonga camping.

lake-tyrrell.name: Lake Tyrrell
lake-tyrrell.bio: Victoria's largest salt lake, 6 km north of Sea Lake, where in dry periods you can walk onto the salt crust.

gunbower-national-park.name: Gunbower National Park
gunbower-national-park.bio: 9,330 ha park beside the Murray between Echuca and Koondrook, with bend camping areas and four wheel driving.

pioneer-settlement.name: Pioneer Settlement
pioneer-settlement.bio: Open-air museum at Swan Hill, opened in 1966, with a one-hour Pyap River Cruise on the paddle steamer Gem.

swan-hill-river-walk.name: Swan Hill River Walk
swan-hill-river-walk.bio: Easy 4.5 km walk along the Murray from the Pump Station on Milloo Street past many of Swan Hill's attractions.

lake-boga-flying-boat-museum.name: Lake Boga Flying Boat Museum
lake-boga-flying-boat-museum.bio: Museum on a secret wartime flying boat repair depot, with a heritage-listed Catalina and an underground bunker.

shepparton-art-museum.name: Shepparton Art Museum
shepparton-art-museum.bio: Shepparton art museum with over 4,000 works, a large ceramics collection and the Namatjira family; entry is free.

kidstown.name: KidsTown
kidstown.bio: Adventure playground on the Midland Highway at Mooroopna, with entry by gold coin donation.

rutherglen-loops.name: Rutherglen Loops
rutherglen-loops.bio: 48 km of walking and cycling trails linking Rutherglen with Wahgunyah, Lake Moodemere and local cellar doors.

lake-mulwala.name: Lake Mulwala
lake-mulwala.bio: Murray reservoir between Yarrawonga and Mulwala, formed by the 1939 weir and popular for boating, kayaking and fishing.
